comment: Shared contract for parsing N8N_RUNNERS_STDLIB_ALLOW / N8N_RUNNERS_EXTERNAL_ALLOW.
The Python runner enforces the allowlist; n8n parses the same strings so it can tell
the workflow builder what a Code node may import. Two parsers, one meaning — this
fixture is what keeps them from drifting.
`modules` is order-insensitive: the Python side returns a set.
`invalid: true` means the runner refuses to start; n8n cannot throw there, so it must
instead report a wildcard, which makes every consumer treat the policy as unverifiable.

cases.name: wildcard with other modules is rejected
wildcard with whitespace and others is rejected
